messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Outcome: refund_full $6.61. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag on either party.. Escalated: False.
Reasoning:
This is a no-show cancellation-fee dispute. The driver cancelled (F4), so the fee can only stand through NS-0 → NS-1, which requires cumulatively: (i) an "I'm Here" press, (ii) GPS presence at the pickup at the moment of the press, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of waiting at the pickup after that press [NS-0][NS-1].

On the tap, the record is internally inconsistent: F7 says driver_pressed_here_at is null, while F6 records a tap at 13:02:45. The execution trace resolves this in the driver's favour — (i) and (ii) pass (tap at 13:02:45, 41 m from pickup) — and I accept that resolution [F6][F1][NS-1]. The clock therefore starts at 13:02:45, not at the platform's auto-arrival marker of 13:01:10.

From the tap, the driver stayed inside the 200 m radius for only 175 s (2 min 55 s) before cancelling at 13:05:40 [F6][F4]. NS-1 (iii) requires strictly more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01). 175 s < 181 s, so requirement (iii) fails [F6][F4][NS-1]. The driver's physical presence (closest approach 38 m at 13:04:30; stationary 3 min 15 s from 13:02:25) and the platform's 4 min 30 s "arrival to cancellation" interval do not cure this, because both are measured before the tap event from which NS-1 (iii) runs [F1][F2][F3][F5][NS-1].

With any one of NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) unmet, NS-2 mandates a full refund of the $6.61 cancellation fee [F8][NS-2][NS-1]. Amount = cancellation fee on record $6.61 [F8][NS-2].

No account flag is warranted: the trace finds no fake tap (the driver was 41 m from pickup when he tapped), and both profiles show 0 disputes and 0 upheld in 90 days, so neither RD-6 nor the NS-2 flag branch is triggered [F6][F1][F16][F17][NS-2].

function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments: {"rider": "Good news: your $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded in full as a Ryde voucher. Here is what decided it. On a driver-cancelled ride, the fee can only stand if the driver tapped \"I'm Here,\" was actually at the pickup when tapping, and then waited more than 3 minutes before cancelling. The driver tapped at 13:02:45 and cancelled at 13:05:40 — only 2 minutes 55 seconds. That falls short of the 3-minute wait, so the fee does not apply. No action needed from you, and this does not affect your account.", "driver": "Your $6.61 cancellation fee for this ride has been refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. Here is why. When you cancel, the fee can only stand if you tapped \"I'm Here\" while at the pickup and then waited more than 3 minutes before cancelling. The tap was recorded at 13:02:45 and the cancellation at 13:05:40 — about 2 minutes 55 seconds, just short of the 3-minute mark. Your location at the tap and time on scene were reviewed and were not in question. No flag has been placed on your account and no action is needed from you."}
